# Draft:Rif Republic Riffan

The Riffan (Arabic: ريڥان) was the intended official currency of the Republic of the Rif, a self-proclaimed state in northern Morocco that existed between 1921 and 1926 under the leadership of Abd el-Krim.
While banknotes were printed and prepared for circulation, historical evidence suggests they were never formally issued to the public before the Republic was dismantled by Spanish and French forces.
